title: Encoding an internal circuit node
statement: For any natural number $n$, any Boolean gate choice $b$, and any list $C$ of circuit trees on $n$ variables, the encoding of the node with gate choice $b$ and children $C$ is the bit $1$, followed by $b$, followed by the encoding of the child list $C$.
hypotheses_covered: $C$ is a list of circuit trees on $n$ variables
